Overview

Cēsis is a city in Cēsis with a population of 17,000. One of Latvia’s oldest towns, a beautifully preserved medieval settlement with a stunning castle complex, a historic old town, and the nearby Gauja National Park. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
